landing.fastBody: No chat. No prompting. No copy-paste loop. Select, shortcut, continue.
landing.privateBody: Your selected text and results aren’t logged or retained. No account required.
landing.workBody: Fix by default. Transform only when you ask. Peek without touching the source.
landing.fixBody: Your voice, minus the typo. Conservative corrections replace the selection in place.
landing.actionsBody: Translate, shorten, or change tone when you explicitly choose to.
landing.peekBody: Translate or explain the selection in a read-only card. Your text stays put.
landing.privacyBody: Concrete privacy behavior. No magic words, no dramatic promises.
landing.transient: Selected text is processed only when you trigger Qwixit.
landing.notLogged: Selected text and model output are not persisted or logged.
landing.noAccount: Download, use your free actions, and keep moving.
landing.pricingBody: Thirty actions arrive each calendar month. Unlimited is there when Qwixit becomes muscle memory.
landing.unlimitedBody: No action counter. Just the shortcut.
landing.finalBody: Select text. Press one shortcut. Keep working.
landing.footerUtility: FAST & SECURE · NATIVE MACOS WRITING UTILITY
